items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: Powell was the leader then. James Powell was the leader and he played clarinet. And we really had a dixieland band.

ctx.x: What kind of band was that? Was that more of a jazz band and blues?
Yeah -- dixieland. We played strictly dixieland, because Powell was the leader then. James Powell was the leader and he played clarinet. And we really had a dixieland band.
Who else was in the band, do you recall?
